method: Each listed item was read with its stem, all options, keyed answer(s), explanations and takeaway. Statuses are manually reasoned, not inferred from a schema or automated pass rule.
limitations: Independent AI editorial/clinical-reasoning screen; not external clinician validation or psychometric validation.
Pass applies only to the recorded content hash. New or changed content requires further review.
No comparison against proprietary examination items; originality judged from author provenance and item content.
Cross-bank learning-objective overlap remains provisional until all batches are available.
Source checks below support only the explicitly associated claims; other category references are general reading unless specifically verified.

items.assessment: Changed alertness requires current swallowing readiness review despite an established dysphagia plan; no consistency guarantees airway protection.
Firm chunks violate minced texture; thickening only liquid does not correct particle size or establish broth consistency.
Upright position and completed swallow before next bolus fit slow-assisted plan; rapid alternation/conversation during swallowing challenge coordination.
Poor fluid acceptance warrants timely individualized swallowing-team review; independent thickness changes may compromise safety or hydration.
Poststroke cheek retention calls for prescribed oral clearance and inspection rather than additional food or unassessed liquid.
Supervised scanning supports rehabilitation for observed neglect; centrally mixing or exclusively right-sided feeding bypasses skill practice.
Adaptive utensil key is sound; reclined bedside feeding is an unrelated unsafe distractor.
issues: Adaptive utensil key is sound; reclined bedside feeding is an unrelated unsafe distractor.
proposedChanges: Replace option2 with: Increase spoonful size to reduce the number of movements. Explain that larger loads can increase spillage and do not improve motor control.

items.assessment: Oral pain is the stated barrier; comfort assessment and care precede more food or education alone.
Small nutrient-dense frequent portions respond to early satiety while safe swallowing excludes a competing texture problem.
Protected meal timing plus reliable assistance address repeated missed feeding; lack of staff help cannot be documented as refusal.
Requested familiar foods already meet ordered diet; coordination supports actual intake and preference without unverified substitutions.
Spreading allowance is correct; reserving the entire allowance until evening is an implausible countermeasure.
issues: Spreading allowance is correct; reserving the entire allowance until evening is an implausible countermeasure.
proposedChanges: Replace option3 with: Keep the breakfast allowance unchanged and give the evening portion only with medications. Explain that small medication portions may not address avoidable early overuse; the whole-day plan should be reviewed.

items.assessment: Oral hygiene and accounting for ice are sound; salty snacks to stimulate drinking contradict the restriction implausibly.
issues: Oral hygiene and accounting for ice are sound; salty snacks to stimulate drinking contradict the restriction implausibly.
proposedChanges: Replace option0 with: Use an alcohol-containing mouth rinse whenever dryness returns. Explain that such rinses may worsen oral dryness rather than relieve it.

items.assessment: Food-specific quantities reveal nutrient pattern more directly than tray fraction or motive labels.
Lentils are the clear substantial plant protein source; classify as foundation nutritional knowledge rather than clinical application.
Package colour/pictures is filler in a nursing teaching decision.
issues: Package colour/pictures is filler in a nursing teaching decision.
proposedChanges: Replace option1 with: Compare sodium per serving without checking how many servings are in the container. Explain that label serving sizes can conceal greater sodium in the amount actually eaten.

items.assessment: Unknown gravy may contain wheat; verifying ingredients is defensible. Rice avoidance tests a recognizable gluten/grain misconception.
Lactose-free equivalent is sound; avoiding breakfast entirely is cartoonish. All-calcium-food removal is also excessively broad.
issues: Lactose-free equivalent is sound; avoiding breakfast entirely is cartoonish. All-calcium-food removal is also excessively broad.
proposedChanges: Replace option1 with: Remove all dairy products before considering a lactose-free option. Replace option3 with: Replace milk with an unfortified plant beverage without reviewing nutrient content. Explain that tolerated/nutritionally comparable alternatives better preserve intake.

items.assessment: Persistent reduced intake and unintentional weight loss support dietitian assessment; timing preference alone is weaker evidence.
Tube flushes cleaning the mouth is an implausible anatomical misconception.
issues: Tube flushes cleaning the mouth is an implausible anatomical misconception.
proposedChanges: Replace option1 with: Use moistened oral swabs alone instead of toothbrushing for a client with natural teeth. Explain that swabs can moisten but do not replace effective plaque removal.

items.assessment: Reviewing intolerance is sound; advancing faster to final rate in nausea is an implausible countermeasure.
issues: Reviewing intolerance is sound; advancing faster to final rate in nausea is an implausible countermeasure.
proposedChanges: Replace option2 with: Give the next prescribed antiemetic and continue rate increases without reassessing symptoms. Explain that symptom suppression does not replace tolerance review before progression.

items.assessment: Normal individual bowel pattern key is defensible, but restricting fluids is irrelevant and diagnosing impaction without cues is weak.
issues: Normal individual bowel pattern key is defensible, but restricting fluids is irrelevant and diagnosing impaction without cues is weak.
proposedChanges: Replace option2 with: The client should aim for a daily bowel movement regardless of comfort. Replace option3 with: Add a stimulant laxative whenever a day passes without stool. Explain that comfortable soft baseline stool does not establish constipation requiring a fixed daily target.

items.assessment: Observed urge after breakfast supports a protected routine; imposed timing or repeated postponement misses the individual pattern.
Correct gradual fibre key is surrounded by unrealistic permanent avoidance, fluid restriction and doubling again.
issues: Correct gradual fibre key is surrounded by unrealistic permanent avoidance, fluid restriction and doubling again.
proposedChanges: Rebuild alternatives as plausible errors: Maintain the abrupt higher amount and expect symptoms to settle without adjustment; Switch immediately to a concentrated fibre supplement at the same increased total; Increase fibre further before reviewing fluid intake. Explain rate of introduction and fluid context for each.

items.assessment: Foot support is correct; indefinite toilet sitting and rigid backward lean are poor distractors.
issues: Foot support is correct; indefinite toilet sitting and rigid backward lean are poor distractors.
proposedChanges: Replace option0 with: Encourage repeated breath-holding and straining to compensate for the high seat. Replace option3 with: Add another raised seat to make transfers easier without reviewing foot contact. Explain that stable feet and safe posture should be assessed rather than compensating with straining or increased height; change existing option2 to a distinct unsupported no-foot-contact posture if needed.
